title: Add xtask repin command; point the version refusal at it
summary: The pin stays exact. Add `cargo run -p xtask -- repin`, which sets `claude_version` in athena.toml to the installed claude's version. `check_pinned` refusals tell whoever runs Athena to run it, in plain wording that does not address an operator role. The audience is whoever runs Athena and currently repins by hand after each Claude Code update.

defaults_applied.how: Command and tests written in Rust in xtask.
Unit tests for rewrite and refusal; test, clippy and fmt criteria.
One command plus a message change.
Criteria check the rewrite and error behavior via tests.
Exact pin stays enforced by check_pinned.
README and message are written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Repin shells out to the same claude binary lookup setup uses, via claude_version-like logic, and rewrites only the claude_version line.
The refusal wording is neutral, addressed to whoever runs Athena, and no longer says to run ./setup.sh alone.
Running repin edits athena.toml at run time; that is the command's job, not a change to the file in this commit.

acceptance_criteria.text: A unit test on the athena.toml rewrite function: given text with claude_version = "2.1.299" and new version 2.1.301, only that line changes; all other lines and comments are byte-identical. Run `cargo test -p xtask`.
Tests show repin refuses empty or unparseable version output and leaves the file unchanged, and makes no change when the installed version already equals the pin. Run `cargo test -p xtask`.

A test in crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs shows check_pinned still errors for a stand-in binary reporting a version other than the pin. The error names both versions and the command `cargo run -p xtask -- repin`. The error text does not use the word 'operator'. A matching version is accepted. Run `cargo test -p athena-agent`.
`cargo run -p xtask -- foo` prints a usage text listing `repin`. `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` pass.
README.md (or docs) tells whoever runs Athena that after a Claude Code update they run `cargo run -p xtask -- repin` and commit the one-line athena.toml change. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
The exact-match rule is unchanged. athena.toml, defaults.toml and .github/workflows are not edited by the change. No secrets or personal data are committed.

out_of_scope: Accepting a range of Claude Code versions
